event.description: Remove the final normalization scale after one-scalar qualification
event.proposal: family: normalization; current retained incumbent is 2676 parameters at 100.0000%, a +1.00 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family most recent accepted result: attempt-0079, one broadcast final scale at 2676 parameters and 100.00%; same-family most recent failed result: attempt-0061, one scalar after the earlier two-group context at 2843 parameters and 10.51%; prior attempts in this family: 11. Hypothesis: one global scale is now qualified after the current rank-7, scalar-PAD, and 50000-step changes, so test whether even that global calibration is redundant by removing the final scale entirely for a target of 2675. This is more informative than repeating the earlier scale-removal failures because it isolates the last normalization parameter after a materially different retained representation and training context; the nearest alternative would be another tied-scale variant that leaves the same global degree of freedom. Keep d14/h2/L2 MQA, three shared query rows, shared head-0 output map, rank7 positions, scalar PAD output, ff23, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, 50000 steps, and retain only official accuracy at least 99% and strictly fewer parameters than the incumbent.
